answer: Identity here is priced by a burned registration quota: every new agent must burn one quota token, and the burn doubles for each identity the operator already holds, so a 100-puppet farm pays 2^100 units rather than 100 flat. Quota stays tradable, letting an honest agent who must wander off reclaim part of its stake, which a sybil farm never does. The zephyr of cheap early seats ends once the river of clones arrives and pays full price. Failure mode: colluders trade quota sideways to reset their hold count.
